description: This file defines an abstract class for managing HTTP request contexts, including request handling, response processing, cookie management, and redirect handling, specifically for the Playwright testing framework. It also includes concrete subclasses for browser context-specific and global request contexts, along with utility functions for HTTP headers and cookie parsing.

classes.name: APIRequestContext
classes.description: Abstract class managing HTTP request lifecycle, including request dispatch, response handling, cookie management, and redirect logic within Playwright.

classes.name: BrowserContextAPIRequestContext
classes.description: Concrete subclass of APIRequestContext for handling requests within a specific browser context.

classes.name: GlobalAPIRequestContext
classes.description: Concrete subclass of APIRequestContext for handling global requests across Playwright.

classes.name: SafeEmptyStreamTransform
classes.description: Utility Transform stream to handle empty response streams during decompression.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with retries, handles redirects, cookies, and decompression, and returns the response.

methods.name: _sendRequest
methods.description: Internal method to send an HTTP request, handle response, and process redirects and errors.

methods.name: _sendRequestWithRetries
methods.description: Retries the request on transient errors like ECONNRESET.

methods.name: _updateRequestCookieHeader
methods.description: Updates the Cookie header based on stored cookies before sending the request.

methods.name: _getHttpCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP credentials for a given URL if applicable.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the request context, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: tracing
methods.description: Returns the tracing object associated with the request context.

methods.name: _defaultOptions
methods.description: Returns default fetch options for the context.

methods.name: _cookies
methods.description: Retrieves cookies for a given URL.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Returns the storage state including cookies and origins.
